extras.title: Choose your business structure
extras.note: Sensible first step for a sole owner.

extras.title: Meet FDA import and USDA animal-material rules if you import
extras.note: Conditional import question is fine, but the agency shown is the Internal Revenue Service instead of FDA/USDA APHIS.

extras.title: Keep business income and expense records
extras.note: Correct IRS guidance, not a filing.

extras.title: File NC sales and use tax returns
extras.note: Follows from sales tax registration (key notes E-500 returns).

extras.title: File North Carolina income tax on business profits
extras.note: True for a NC resident sole proprietor, though no quote.

extras.title: Buncombe County business personal property listing
extras.note: NC does require yearly listing of business personal property; shown without a quote.

extras.title: Permission to sell at Asheville-area markets and events
extras.note: Market/event approval is plausible for a market seller, but mostly from organizers, not the city.
